meta.title: Izacki, independent game studio
meta.description: Izacki is an independent game studio. FERRA and Tower Défense Infini are free, and the Launcher installs and updates them on Windows.

hero.lead: Izacki is an independent game studio. FERRA and Tower Défense Infini are free: you install, launch and update them from the Launcher, on Windows.
hero.plateAlt: The Boutique (store) screen of the Izacki Launcher: a featured game, then FERRA and Tower Défense Infini, with filters for all games, Izacki games, community games and free games.

games.label: Games
games.title: Two games, two genres.
games.ferraAlt: FERRA screenshot: a camp around the fire, with drills, furnaces, a house and street lamps.
games.tdAlt: Tower Défense Infini screenshot: the “Roi des Enfers” boss advances beneath its health bar during the “Éclipse” event on the “Chaos Total” map.
games.ferraText: A world to rebuild, a fire to protect, a meteorite to face. Mine, automate, defend your camp, and get ready for the night.
games.tdText: A tower defense against endless waves of zombies: you place towers along the road and see how long you can hold.

launcher.label: Launcher
launcher.title: Install, launch, update.
launcher.lead: The Izacki Launcher brings together the store, your library, the community, the creators' space and support. It updates itself and checks the integrity of an Izacki game before launching it.
launcher.names: The space names are the ones used in the Launcher, which is in French.

store.title: Boutique
store.text: The store: search, and filters for all games, Izacki games, community games or free games. Izacki's games are free; community games have a price in credits, sometimes zero.

library.title: Bibliothèque
library.text: The library: your installed games, with search and sorting. Each game has four tabs for overview, achievements, news and information. Updates and installations are in the Downloads section.

community.title: Communauté
community.text: The community: friends and groups with chat, a leaderboard and a link to the Discord. You add a friend with their tag, in the form Username#Number.

creators.title: Créateurs
creators.text: The creators' space: publish a game, follow its sales and its withdrawals. The team reviews every game before it goes live.

support.title: Assistance
support.text: Support: for a question, a bug or a refund, you open a ticket. You can attach a screenshot, and the reply arrives in the ticket.

all.title: See everything
all.text: The Launcher page details each space, the required setup and installation help.

versions.label: Versions
versions.title: Latest versions.
versions.lead: The full release notes for the games are on their pages and in the What's new tab of the Launcher.

forum.title: Izacki forum
forum.text: Chat, ask for help, suggest ideas or report a bug. A free Izacki account is enough to write.

discord.text: Meet the community on Izacki's Discord server, also reachable from the Community space of the Launcher.

support.title: Support
support.text: Answers to common questions are in the FAQ. For a bug or a refund, open a ticket from the Support space of the Launcher; the reply arrives in the ticket.

publish.title: Publish a game
publish.text: To publish your game, use the Creators space of the Launcher: you send the game with a name, a price and visuals. The team reviews every game before publication.

band.title: Install the Launcher, then launch FERRA or Tower Défense Infini.
